title: His saxophone lessons with Lorenzo Tio and the Carl Fischer method
summary: Foster got only a few weeks of lessons with Tio before Tio left for New York, learning the fingering and working out of the Carl Fischer method.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees

blocks.x: Can you think of anything in your saxophone lessons about T.O. with any method book that he used or anything special that he taught you?
Well, I didn't get that far with T.O. Because T.O. went to, uh, he went to, uh, New York during the time. In fact, I was a kid.

When I went to the other side, he went to the head and there was about a month, I see, here. He went to New York and came back and decided to go back. That's how it was. He did go back. I remember, well, this is the day, he said, well, I'd like to do it well, my boy. He said, Greg, you're going to make a wonderful saxophone player. He said, I'll tell you about it, he said, I am only going to be on here about four more weeks. And he was only about four weeks that he was here. He wasn't in New York. He was living on, I think, uh, Allen?
Oh, no, not Allen. Russia Bled. Russia Bled, right? At that time, you talking about him and him were riding on Russia Bled.
Yeah, that's right. Yeah. Not from the country or somewhere around the house.
That's part of the way Brennan lived now, doesn't it? Well, what did he show you? Just the fingering of the...
Yeah, I just take the... that's the only time, in other words, to... I was the first book of saxophone.
Len, when you went to Davy Jones, did you work out of a book?
Yes, I worked out of a... of Carl Fisher Method. Carl Fisher Method. Yeah, Carl Fisher Method.
